import unittest
import sensor_clean as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings([4, 0, None, -2]), [4, 0, -2])
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings([0, None, 0]), [0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings([None, None]), [])
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings([]), [])
    def test_input_preserved(self):
        values = [None, -5, 0, 8]
        result = app.valid_readings(values)
        self.assertEqual(values, [None, -5, 0, 8])
        self.assertIsNot(result, values)
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings(result), [-5, 0, 8])

    def test_additional_behavior(self):
        result = app.valid_readings([None, 0, -7, 0, None])
        self.assertEqual(result, [0, -7, 0])
        self.assertEqual(app.valid_readings(result), [0, -7, 0])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
